description: This PHP script provides functions for switching and configuring web editors (CKEditor, TinyMCE, or none) within the TestLink project, including loading configuration files and setting up editor instances with locale-specific settings.

classes.name: ckeditorInterface
classes.description: Class used to interface with CKEditor, configuring its base path, language, and toolbar.

classes.name: tinymce
classes.description: Class used to configure TinyMCE editor instances.

classes.name: no_editor
classes.description: Class used when no editor is selected, providing basic text area functionality.

methods.name: require_web_editor
methods.description: Determines which editor class file to include based on the editor type.

methods.name: web_editor
methods.description: Initializes and returns an editor instance configured according to the selected editor type and locale.
